[\"单调栈：仍然考虑每一根柱子左右第一个小于其高度的柱子。使用单调栈维护柱子的.en: Monotonic stack: still consider for each pillar the first pillar on the left and right that is shorter than its height. Use a monotonic stack to maintain ascending pillar heights; if a pillar's height decreases, pop all non-conforming pillars. After popping, the top of the remaining stack is the first pillar on the left shorter than its height. Each pillar is only popped once, and the pillar that pops it the first time is the first one on its right that is less than or equal to its height. Note that the right side includes pillars of equal height, but in this case, the rightmost pillar retains the correct answer. Monotonic stacks can solve finding the first smaller number on the left and right in a 1D array. If you need the exact right boundary, just scan from right to left again.
